headline.text: The Spanish label reports lymphoma cases with adalimumab and azathioprine or mercaptopurine.

reported.text: The Spanish adalimumab label describes hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma cases in young adults receiving azathioprine or mercaptopurine for inflammatory bowel disease.

claims.text: The Spanish adalimumab label describes hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma cases in young adults receiving azathioprine or mercaptopurine for inflammatory bowel disease.
claims.quote: Algunos de estos linfomas hepatoesplénicos de células T con Humira se han presentado en pacientes adultos jóvenes en tratamiento concomitante con azatioprina o 6 - mercaptopurina utilizada para la enfermedad inflamatoria intestinal.
claims.quoteEnglish: Some of these hepatosplenic T-cell lymphomas with Humira occurred in young adult patients receiving concomitant azathioprine or 6-mercaptopurine for inflammatory bowel disease.
claims.judgeRationale: The Spanish warning explicitly describes these lymphoma cases in young adults receiving concomitant azathioprine or mercaptopurine; the claim retains both alternatives and the reported population.

pharmacistQuestions.text: The label describes this interaction, but there seem to be no human studies of it. How is it usually handled for someone like me?
